payload.body_you:
You are entering a period where your life stops rewarding effort spent proving yourself to other people. The version of you that answers every request, defends every decision, and keeps moving so no one can question your competence starts costing more than it gives back. You may have less energy for being available on demand, less patience for people who expect the old version of you, and a much sharper sense of what deserves your time.

Do not rush the plan that is supposed to carry the next several years. Give it the skills, money, support, and proof it needs before asking it to hold more weight. But do not confuse preparation with waiting. Finish the work already in front of you. Keep the appointment. Send the application. Build the part you can build now.
